# Preface {.unnumbered}

Wagwaan! This book is my journey and record of learning **R** . Still ongoing. A labour of love and hate – mostly hate.

Started these notes on 20 July 2026, should have started sooner – I know!. They began as plain R scripts that I wrote for myself as I worked through the book, and I’ve turned them into this Quarto book or whatever!

## What's in here?

So far I've worked through:

- @sec-data-visualisation: making plots with ggplot2
- @sec-workflow-basics: the basics of writing R code
- @sec-data-transformation: filtering, sorting, and summarising data with dplyr
- @sec-code-style: writing tidy, readable code
- @sec-data-tidying: reshaping data with tidyr
- @sec-workflow-scripts-projects: scripts and projects (coming soon)
- @sec-data-import: reading data into R with readr (in progress)

More chapters will be added as I go.

## How to read this book

::: callout-note
These are just my notes, they are not the gospel, obviously. Take them with a pinch of salt.
:::

- Every code chunk is real R code.
- Some code is shown but not run, for example code that only works in RStudio or installs packages.
- Some code fails **on purpose**, to show what a particular error looks like.
- The exercises come from the R4DS book, and the answers are my own attempts. The code is surely not perfect or efficient. Feel free to write your own.
